annotation_method: Source-grounded seed judgments made during implementation, not independent clinician annotations. Relevant means the chunk directly answers the stated question, including its age or disease qualifiers. All indexed text was searched for corresponding recommendation clauses. This small diagnostic set includes the known aspirin failure and is not an unbiased test corpus.
